name: komdosh-dev-infra-core
description: Must-have foundation for infrastructure-as-code and GitOps work — the shared safety, secrets-hygiene, promotion, and data-protection discipline every infra plugin builds on. Ships three read-only agents (infra-reviewer — correctness · security · blast radius · drift · cost · reversibility; secrets-sentinel — leak audit across every layer; data-protection-auditor — PII across the data lifecycle with 152-FZ + GDPR), three internal skills (discover-infra-context repo-mapper, infra-safety-scan and pii-exposure-scan grep preflights), six rule documents (iac-safety, secrets-hygiene, gitops-principles, environment-promotion, infra-review, pii-data-protection), a millisecond-scale SessionStart context hook, and a recommended read-only permission set. Standalone — no cloud or language assumptions; the terraform, kubernetes, argocd, and yandex plugins depend on it.
